## Strongest current system statement

Fresh construction always finishes in the Lean model. Under the stated
guard conditions, its result represents exactly the specified finite
trees. A completed supported root reduction with empty inherited
constraints preserves that exact language. General reduction completion
and whole-library Haskell refinement remain open. Read
`notes-current-system-claim.md` for the exact contracts.

## New checked result

`SourceCurrentProjectionReadSpine.project` derives an indexed history from
an actual projection and selected complete row read. The root retains
the actual read, which can unfold Mu. Ordinary steps retain the canonical
result row, a raw union-row preimage, the selected projected operand, its
actual ReadAll prefix, Read and suffix, and the corresponding source row
and signed child lookup. The recursive witness uses that same child call
and operand read. Missing children do not add projected operand positions.

The raw union index is some equal full-row preimage. It is not asserted
to equal the earlier read rows' length plus the selected read index.
The actual selected operand and its read determine the causal branch.
Successful effects supply intermediate readiness and availability.
Closed inputs and desired source ancestry are not premises.

`SourceCurrentClassObservationSpines.node` starts from the original false
NodeTrace and its historical semantic, union-normal and availability
facts. It also takes a Required Origin and an actual completed node edit.
The observation starts at the edit's returned heap. Actual edit effects
derive semantic and cost support and result availability at that heap.
The producer constructs path safety from the original gate and Origin.
It does not require a false gate on the prepared or edited value.

For a selected nonplain row, the conclusion has two cases. An ordinary
source has a Route at the same requested path in the original value and
the same symbol, full guard and arity. The other case retains an actual
native leaf or Head cut in the same edit execution. Each cut retains the
remaining projection and selected complete row read. A leaf observes its
actual returned native value. A Head observes its body edit's returned
value. Its exposed value need not remain unchanged.

Every ordinary lift retains the exact selected signed child position,
canonical source row, raw rebuilt row, original raw row, actual child
slice, prefix and suffix edit graphs, captured states and memo bundles.
The selected recursive witness uses that same child and read interval.
Equal child values cannot substitute a different sibling position.
`ProjectionFrame` indexes its fields by the exact outer Project, Read,
selected position and row. `Reconstruction` exposes the existing Rebuild
witness as dependent fields. It adds no second preservation argument.

Initial shared readiness, populated and allowed edits, domain safety,
memo validity and native writer history remain explicit. The actual read
entry also requires semantic support, forward Keeps from the projection
return, and the causal guard heap. Growth alone does not supply that guard
heap. The proof restricts existing guard facts backwards through retained
records when it follows an earlier actual read interval.

## Constructed recursive check

Two distinct source-built used Mu values have body guards `[[[0],[1]]]`
and `[[[0],[2]]]`. The record has coherent active paths `[[0],[1]]`.
Its original primary gate returns true. Required preserves both inputs.
A literal class call returns a used Mu with the combined full guard
`[[[0],[1],[2]]]` in its unfolded row. The returned Mu has no direct
ordinary rows. Its actual read reconstructs three self children.

The fixture checks nonempty projection `[0]`, forest projection `[0,0]`,
the actual Head and internal warm Mu read, and the final selected row.
It derives support from the actual class return and initial Frame, Fits
and sufficient numeric width. It applies the new projection producer and
the leaf constructor with its actual leaf receipt and suffix Keeps.
It does not invoke the false-primary node producer. It does not assert
that the outer driver selects this class. No finite-tree productivity,
language failure, nontermination or Haskell defect is asserted.
